scope: The unmodified linked packages run under strict fm1-live at 360 MHz. Physical matrix acquisition, glass and the mask ROM updater itself remain outside this receipt. Update entry uses an emulated cable or the two emulated octave buttons.
fullFrameOracle: Each whole LCD framebuffer is converted losslessly back to the archive's RGB565 source palette. Probe timestamps are the first matching 16 ms samples. Native hardware duties and IRQ execution are modeled.
calibration: The stock matrix scanner accepts a rotated mapping of 14 buttons and seven encoders with alternating directions. The resulting 32 bytes match both the RAM panel object and the stored copy at 0xA5100. Only the panel object's 4 KiB sector changes. A fresh emulator process restores the mapping from the saved flash without any flash operation.
updater: USB Device Inquiry has a valid reply before the request, screen, detach and PR_PWR reset. Keeping the two octave buttons down for five seconds independently produces the other updater screen and reset. Each new application's boot counter reaches two. Neither updater case writes a flash byte.
